messages:
Samir Khatri: Short heads-up: rolling release train notice. We're entering a scoped freeze for the next 48h to run a DB migration rehearsal. Block: schema, storage routing, large backfills. Allow: hotpatches, security fixes, telemetry-only toggles.

Jen Park: Noted. Can you confirm labeling and exemption path so teams can proceed? I'll update release-docs.

Alex Mora: Canary check earlier showed embed path p95 up ~15%. I'm provisioning one extra GPU pool and increasing scale buffer for the window.

deploy-bot: Policy: PRs labeled `deploy:freeze-hold` will be auto-blocked. Use `deploy:urgent` + PD approval for emergencies.

Lina Gomez: I'll notify integrators and add an internal status banner. Expect small throughput variability.

Samir Khatri: Canary snapshot 09:05 UTC: embed p50 30ms, p95 205ms (baseline 180ms). Error rate steady. Some warmup timeouts on model-loader.

Alex Mora: Quick log command:
kubectl -n canary logs -l app=embedder --since=10m | egrep "timeout|model-loader" -A2
(artifacts in s3://redwood-canary-logs/)

Jen Park: Rollback criteria in runbook: auto-rollback if error rate >0.6% OR p95 > baseline +220ms for 10m. Oncall to confirm before manual escalation.

Maya Rivera (oncall): I'll monitor dashboards and set an alert matching rollback criteria. Will page release leads if triggered.

Samir Khatri: Proposed lift: Sat 20:00 UTC if we have 24h of stability. Otherwise extend in 24h increments after quick ops sync. Please ack. :thumbsup:

Jen Park: +1, posting summary to #product and #customer-ops.

Lina Gomez: +1 from partner comms.

Alex Mora: +1, attaching dashboards to release doc.

deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled: status posts every 3h until freeze lifted.

Samir Khatri: Thanks all, will send an exec note if anything changes.
